verdict.rationale: No evidence of a dedicated 'pulumi validate' or 'pulumi fmt' style command that checks/auto-formats configuration prior to planning; Pulumi's docs only show 'pulumi preview' as a plan-preview step, and formatting is left to standard language tooling since Pulumi programs are written in general-purpose languages. missing for 10: no documented config validation command, no auto-formatting feature, no evidence of pre-plan syntax/config linting distinct from preview.
